name: Astera Labs
thesis: Astera Labs sells PCIe, CXL and Ethernet connectivity chips for AI racks; Q2 revenue was $392M (+105% y/y). It was $265.82 (+2.4%) early Tuesday Oct 27 as Celestica's $40B 2027 guide lifted AI hardware; still about 30% below the Oct 7 close of $382.25. No company news since Oct 12.
risks: A beta near 3.8 means 10% days on sector headlines alone; Meta's Q3 filing showed $810B of future lease and contract commitments, which fed worries about debt-funded AI build-outs.
catalyst: Alphabet and Microsoft capex comments Oct 28-29 US (Oct 29-30 AEDT); Q3 results Nov 3 after US close, call 4:30pm ET (08:30 AEDT Wed Nov 4).

name: Broadcom
thesis: Broadcom supplies custom AI accelerators (Google, Meta, OpenAI, Anthropic) plus Ethernet networking and VMware. On Oct 26 BofA, Citi, Morgan Stanley and Blackstone lined up $63B for a vehicle that buys Broadcom chips and networking and leases them to Anthropic, deliveries from 2027. DA Davidson upgraded to Buy ($400). AVGO was $341.90 (+3.9%) early Tuesday.
risks: Broadcom gives residual-value support to the Anthropic lenders (on an earlier $35B deal the backstop was up to $29B), so it carries equipment-value risk; Moody's warns risk rises if more such deals follow quickly. It also weighed buying Meta stock.
catalyst: Alphabet and Microsoft capex comments Oct 28-29 US (Oct 29-30 AEDT); Q4 FY26 results around Dec 10 (not yet confirmed).

name: Celestica
thesis: Celestica builds 800G/1.6T networking switches, servers and storage for hyperscalers. Q3 revenue was $5.83B (+83%) and adjusted EPS $3.30 (guide $2.88-3.08); CCS +102%. 2026 raised to $21.0B / $11.55 EPS, and the first 2027 outlook is $40B revenue (+90%), $21.50 EPS and a 9.0% margin, against consensus near $35.7B. The stock was $272.20 (+10.4%) early Tuesday, about 12.7x the 2027 EPS guide. Upgraded to accumulate, conviction high.
risks: 2026 free cash flow cut to $460M from $600M to fund working capital, and 2027 capex is $1.5-2.0B; the release also cites a $3.45B public offering. Margins stay single-digit and a few hyperscalers drive most revenue.
catalyst: New share buyback (up to 2.5% of float) to be filed in Q4 after the current one expires Nov 2; Q4 results late January (guide $6.275-6.575B revenue, $3.37-3.57 EPS).

name: Credo Technology
thesis: Credo sells active electrical cables (AECs), optical DSPs and retimers; fiscal Q1 2027 revenue was $479M (+115% y/y). It fell 19.2% over Oct 22-23 after MaxLinear said it will target 20-30% of 1.6T AECs, and was $158.88 (+5.1%) early Tuesday Oct 27 in the Celestica-led rebound, with no company news. Conviction stays low until fiscal Q2 shows the 1.6T ramp.
risks: A credible second source in AECs would hit pricing from fiscal 2028; a few hyperscalers drive most revenue, and the CEO and CTO have been selling under 10b5-1 plans.
catalyst: Fiscal Q2 2027 quarter ends about Oct 31; results around Nov 30-early December (date not announced).

name: SK hynix
thesis: Q3 operating profit ~KRW 83.3T (+38% QoQ), revenue over KRW 100T for the first time, ~80% operating margin. HBM4 in full mass production and expected to overtake HBM3E in Q4.
risks: Net income fell ~58% QoQ because Q2 had a one-off Kioxia gain. The memory cycle is at a peak, and the stock is crowded.
catalyst: Q4 HBM4 mix shift; 2026 shareholder return plan (~$75B reported)

name: Bloom Energy
thesis: Bloom makes solid-oxide fuel cells for onsite data-centre power. Q3 revenue was a record $1.236B (+138% y/y), adjusted EPS $0.94 vs $0.69, and 2026 guidance was raised to $4.4-4.6B. After falling 19% over Oct 22-23 it has rebounded: $221.07 (+8.4%) early Tuesday Oct 27, about 15% above the Oct 23 close, with Barclays raising its target to $316.
risks: Capex of $153M (from $12M) to double capacity turned Q3 cash flow negative; delivery depends on Oracle and Brookfield sites arriving on time; Jefferies cut its target to $242 from $289 after the print.
catalyst: Oracle Jupiter permit Nov 23; 2027 guidance and backlog figure with Q4 results (February).

name: GE Vernova
thesis: Q3 orders ~$29.3B (+96% YoY), equipment orders +134%, backlog ~$197-200B. Full-year guidance raised on all key metrics; buyback lifted from $10B to $20B. Gas backlog 53 to 64 GW.
risks: Agreed to buy Trench Group (~$9B per one report), which adds integration risk. Missed EBIT estimates five quarters running before this one. AI power names sold off in mid-October on worries about how AI builds get funded.
catalyst: Trench deal close; Q4 orders and gas slot conversion

name: Vertiv
thesis: Vertiv sells power, thermal and liquid-cooling gear for data centres; it guided Q3 sales to $3.65-3.85B and FY26 EPS to $6.65-6.75. On Oct 27 it closed the $1.45B cash purchase of UtilityInnovation Group (microgrid controls, behind-the-meter power; up to $1.15B more in earnout, about 13x 2027 EBITDA, accretive in year one), a day after closing King Environmental. VRT was $207.43 (+3.8%) early Tuesday.
risks: The stock trades on the 2027 hyperscaler-capex debate rather than guidance; two deals in two days add integration work and a possible $1.15B earnout; liquid-cooling price competition is rising.
catalyst: Q3 results Wed Oct 28 before US open; call 11:00am ET (02:00 AEDT Thu Oct 29).

name: Robinhood Markets
thesis: Record Q3 revenue of $1.42B (+12% YoY), slightly under consensus. Options revenue +31% to $399M, event contracts $173M (more than 6x). Net deposits $15.7B, funded customers 28.7M (+7%), Gold subscribers 5.2M. Top of the opex outlook cut by $25M.
risks: Crypto revenue $120M (-55% YoY); crypto volume -38%. GAAP EPS $0.51 missed the $0.55 consensus. Opex +16%. Shares fell about 8% premarket on Oct 28.
catalyst: Crypto volume recovery; prediction markets growth

name: MercadoLibre
thesis: MercadoLibre runs Latin America's largest marketplace, logistics network and Mercado Pago; Q2 net revenue was $10.2B (+50% y/y) while operating income fell 17%. It fell 7.8% to $1,668.72 on Oct 26 after Lula's runoff win; Citi upgraded it to Buy on Oct 27 ($2,050 target), calling the selloff an entry point, and it was $1,711.00 (+2.5%) early that day.
risks: Real futures fell about 10% overnight, which cuts reported US-dollar revenue from Brazil, its biggest market; an annulment fight would extend the uncertainty. Margins are being absorbed by the credit book and logistics.
catalyst: Q3 results Nov 4 (provisional on the company's IR page, not yet confirmed; recent calls 5:00pm ET = 09:00 AEDT Thu Nov 5).

name: Cloudflare
thesis: Cloudflare runs a global edge network selling security, CDN, zero-trust and the Workers developer platform; Q2 revenue was $696M (+36%) and it guided Q3 to $736-737M. It was $331.00 early Tuesday Oct 27, near flat, holding the Oct 22-24 cybersecurity rally while chips rebounded.
risks: The stock has had 38 moves of more than 5% in a year and now sits close to the consensus target, so Q3 has to beat and raise.
catalyst: Q3 results Thu Nov 5 after US close, call 5:00pm ET (09:00 AEDT Fri Nov 6).

name: Sea Limited
thesis: Sea runs Shopee, Monee (digital finance) and Garena across Southeast Asia and Brazil; Q2 revenue was $7.79B (+48%). New Street cut it to Neutral ($70) on Oct 26 after the Oct 20 Sea Cloud launch; it was $74.26 early Oct 27, about 3% above the Oct 26 low. Q3 date confirmed Oct 27 for Nov 10.
risks: A new cloud business adds spending with no disclosed budget while Shopee fights TikTok Shop, Temu and Shein; Brazil (a Shopee growth market) took a hit to its currency after Lula's win. DBS and New Street have both cut. Weakest name on the list.
catalyst: Q3 results Tue Nov 10 before US open, call 7:30am ET (23:30 AEDT Tue Nov 10); any Sea Cloud capex figure or Monee IPO timing.

name: Keyence
thesis: Keyence sells machine-vision, sensors and measurement gear direct to factories with industry-leading margins and no debt. It closed Oct 27 at JPY 79,080 (+2.3%, about US$502 at 157.4), recovering the Oct 26 dip, two days before fiscal Q2. Lam's record quarter and supply-constrained guide point to continued fab spending, a core end market.
risks: Orders follow the factory-capex cycle within a quarter, Q1 EPS slightly missed, and a stronger yen (BOJ meets Oct 29-30) cuts reported overseas revenue.
catalyst: Fiscal Q2 results Thu Oct 29 after Tokyo close (time TBC); BOJ decision Fri Oct 30.

name: ASML Holding
thesis: ASML is the only supplier of EUV lithography tools; Q3 sales were a record EUR 11.66B and it guided 2026 to EUR 44-45B, saying 2027-28 supply will not fully meet demand. The ADR fell 6.9% on Oct 22 after Lam warned of supply limits into 2027 and was $1,605.19 (+1.0%) early Tuesday Oct 27. Demand is not the issue.
risks: Semicap is priced for perfection and the SOX is in a bear market (26% off its June high); China is about 20% of ASML sales and export rules can change.
catalyst: Interim dividend EUR 1.88 payable Nov 4; Q4 results January (date TBC).

name: Teradyne
thesis: Q3 revenue $1,306M vs $769M a year ago; non-GAAP EPS $2.29. Semi Test $1,072M. Results came in above the top of guidance.
risks: Revenue slightly below Q2's $1,329M. Robotics is small ($96M). I did not get Q4 guidance, and one outlet reported conflicting weak figures.
catalyst: Q4 guidance; AI accelerator and HBM test demand
